editionData.description: Global headlines: Poland says Russian missiles hit its territory; Trump calls it a mistake (Poland also joined other European countries in expressing outrage over allegations of a thwarted plot linked to Moscow to kill a U.S.-Ukrainian rapper on Danish soil); Researchers tracked a long-legged bird’s migration. He flew 6,800 miles. (Conservationists say the journey made by the bird, a bar-tailed godwit called Phil, was an "incredible feat."); and Zelensky suggests new round of peace talks could happen during G-20 summit (The Ukrainian president wants to join President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin for trilateral peace talks next month in Miami). Markets leaned higher, with 7 of 7 tracked indexes up; S&P 500 up 0.00% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize parts to lower costs (Japan’s automakers will work together to lower production costs as they band together to compete against China’s growing automotive sector); Pill to treat pancreatic cancer hailed as 'biggest breakthrough in decades' (Cancer undetectable for one in 12 patients in daraxonrasib trial, while nearly all participants’ tumours stopped growing); and Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis (Lean verification of the Riemann Hypothesis Joint statement by the Lean and Mathlib communities, endorsed by the Lean FRO and the Mathlib...). headlines.title: Poland says Russian missiles hit its territory; Trump calls it a mistake
headlines.summary: Poland also joined other European countries in expressing outrage over allegations of a thwarted plot linked to Moscow to kill a U.S.-Ukrainian rapper on Danish soil.

headlines.title: Researchers tracked a long-legged bird’s migration. He flew 6,800 miles.
headlines.summary: Conservationists say the journey made by the bird, a bar-tailed godwit called Phil, was an "incredible feat."

headlines.title: Zelensky suggests new round of peace talks could happen during G-20 summit
headlines.summary: The Ukrainian president wants to join President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin for trilateral peace talks next month in Miami.

headlines.title: In secret memo, Hegseth restricts U.S.-Canada defense relationship
headlines.summary: The classified directive is another provocation in the Trump administration’s feud with Ottawa. One U.S. official said it’s sure to be seen as a “slap in the face.”

headlines.title: Senegal’s farmers are working on climate change’s front line
headlines.summary: In a part of Africa where temperatures are rising more quickly than the rest of the world, people are adapting. But the future is uncertain.

headlines.title: Iran targets US air defence radars in Bahrain; Houthi strikes continue
headlines.summary: Bahrain has condemned Iran's strikes on US military assets in the Gulf country, as Houthis keep Saudi Arabia on edge.

headlines.title: Indonesia factory fire kills three, 36 missing
headlines.summary: At least 15 people rescued, including four taken to hospital, as authorities say it is unclear what caused the blaze.

headlines.title: COP31 climate talks close to final deal, summit president says
headlines.summary: New draft would acknowledge for the first time that global ⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠warming is on course to pass 1.5°C.

headlines.title: Why is the US Army detonating lead-rich explosives in Iowa?
headlines.summary: The delayed blasts have stoked environmental fears and concerns about health effects in the state.

headlines.title: Eleven killed in burst of violence during Mexican cartel leader’s capture
headlines.summary: Seven alleged cartel gunmen and four soldiers were killed in operation to arrest cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores.

headlines.title: Trump orders federal contractors to check with White House before responding to Congress
headlines.summary: President Trump is directing federal contractors to consult the White House about inquiries from Congress and to withhold any communications that his administration considers privileged.

headlines.title: Google employees protest AI in schools policy
headlines.summary: More than 550 Google employees signed a petition to allow schools access to Search without AI. Parents and educators protested outside Google offices in 6 cities last week for the same ask.

headlines.title: Highlights and challenges from covering an historic month in South America
headlines.summary: NPR's South America Correspondent discusses her work covering an historic election upset and a papal visit.

headlines.title: Bayer reaches Roundup settlement that could cost the company billions
headlines.summary: The money will go to thousands of people who have been or will be diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma – a blood cancer linked to the herbicide.

headlines.title: Storms expected on both coasts threatens Thanksgiving travel
headlines.summary: The mayor of San Francisco is asking people in the city not to travel unless "absolutely essential." Meanwhile, a storm moving up the Eastern seaboard could also cause travel delays ahead of Thanksgiving.

headlines.title: Shenzhen Outlook marks new milestone, says FM
headlines.summary: Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Thursday that APEC economic leaders had adopted an ambitious, practical and comprehensive Shenzhen Outlook, marking a new milestone in APEC cooperation and advancing the building of an Asia-Pacific community.

headlines.title: Full text: APEC Connectivity Blueprint
headlines.summary: SHENZHEN -- The 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting adopted APEC Connectivity Blueprint on Thursday.

headlines.title: China, UK seek closer cooperation in healthcare
headlines.summary: The second China-UK Health Innovation Dialogue in London, England, on Monday brought together government officials, regulators, business leaders, and academics from both countries to explore opportunities for closer cooperation in healthcare.

headlines.title: South Africa eyes China in push to diversify agricultural exports
headlines.summary: South African agricultural exporters are looking to China and other Asian markets to cushion the impact of the country's impending exclusion from the African Growth and Opportunity Act, or AGOA, as producers seek to protect export earnings and jobs by diversifying their traditional markets.

headlines.title: Yeoh, Kan, Yao to be honored for bridging cultures
headlines.summary: The Committee of 100 announced on Thursday that it will honor actress Michelle Yeoh, television producer Yue-Sai Kan and basketball star Yao Ming for their work connecting audiences and communities in the US and China.

headlines.title: Kashmir’s famed saffron fields have been used as dumping grounds for three years: Mehbooba Mufti
headlines.summary: Mehbooba Mufti says municipal waste dumping in Pampore has damaged nearly 2,000 kanals of Kashmir’s saffron fields and threatened the livelihoods of 150 families. The NGT has ordered an inspection.

headlines.title: Tenure focused on institutional reform-oriented approach, says outgoing UPPSC Chairman Sanjay Shrinet
headlines.summary: Outgoing UPPSC Chairman Sanjay Shrinet touts tenure-driven, reform-focused, tech-enabled integrity and speedy examinations with strict transparency.
